question: Who among the following Indian musicians was a part of a band named 'Planet Drum' along with Mickey Hart, Sikiru Adepoju, and Giovanni Hidalgo, whose first album received the 1992 Grammy Award for Best World Music Album, which was the first Grammy in this category?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Zakir Hussain.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **On 8 February 2009 for the 51st Grammy Awards**, **Zakir Hussain won the Grammy in the Contemporary World Music Album** category for his collaborative album **"Global Drum Project"** along with** Mickey Hart, Sikiru Adepoju & Giovanni Hidalgo.**
